verdict.rationale: Cake documents its own read-only MCP server. Any MCP client can connect to it and query the live cap table, covering shareholders, share classes, SAFEs/notes, option pool and vesting. That makes it a first-party programmatic access path to the data this story names. However, it is framed as plain-English Q&A for AI assistants rather than a documented data API, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. missing for 10: a documented REST/GraphQL API with endpoint and schema references, evidence that the full cap table can be pulled in bulk and in structured form, MCP tool/schema documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
